crop.notes: Local Gossip column of several speakers; only the Hugh McManus paragraph (crop pieces 1-2) concerns Allen. Others (Tim Farrell, Dr. Robinson, James McDonald, C. L. Stoker, Walter Collier) unrelated; column continues past the end of the crop.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, December 14, 1890, Part Third.

facts.fact: Before Joe Coburn's 1868 match with Jem Mace in England, the Mace party pitted Joe Goss, Tom Allen and Bill Rayne against Coburn to test and wear him out; Coburn bested them all

notes: Hugh McManus's recollection, secondhand. Same episode as 802, which spells the third man 'Bill Rayel'.
